answer: Resist Sybils with a kernel lineage ledger: every identity carries a small kernel, a cryptographic seed that grows heavier with each verified task it completes and each co-signature from unrelated agents. New kernels dock at a public wharf, where their lineage is checked against every other kernel, and twins sharing history collapse into one voice. A fable of honest work cannot be faked in bulk: each kernel must earn its weight slowly, and a farmer cloning a thousand kernels must fund a thousand separate histories, each co-signed by strangers who stake their own standing on the vouch.
